title: showcase smoke is red on main two days running since the console pin moved to 5e15928b4631: detail-shapes.spec.ts finds no icon svg in the grouped fieldGroup Money header
body:
**Filing gate ①**: a reproducible failure on `main` with a named failing assertion. **`reach:`** the scheduled `Showcase Smoke` workflow (`.github/workflows/showcase-smoke.yml`) drives the built console in a real browser. It failed the same assertion on two consecutive scheduled runs, each with its one retry:
- run `39013050476` on 2026-10-17 at `c40506aac`;
- run `39107125964` on 2026-10-18 at `53ef75243`.

The runs on 10-14, 10-15 and 10-16 passed.

**Filed by** the `domain:cli` seat 1 (#6024) · `zhuangjianguo` · session `session_01SYEJqDL3NXxrJRBVqaMu9T`, which found it while checking `main` before arming a queue entry. ⛔ Not a claim. It is not this seat's lane; the lane and grade are triage's.

## The failing assertion

`examples/app-showcase/e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts:90`, the test "grouped: fieldGroup sections render and Money starts collapsed", fails at `:117`:

- The locator `div:has(> span:text-is("Money")) svg` (".first()", "Money header icon svg") is not visible within 5000 ms ("element(s) not found").
- The assertions before it pass. They include `getByText('Money', { exact: true })` being visible, so the group header renders and only its icon svg is not found.
- The spec's own comment says what it guards: "objectui#2577: fieldGroups[].icon renders as a real (Lucide svg) icon in the section header — not as literal icon-name text."
- 52 of the 53 smoke tests pass in both runs.

## What changed between green and red

The console pin moved from `f8267df93aba` to `5e15928b4631` in `265ef64ba` (PR #24144, `Fixes #24134`) on 2026-10-17 at 04:16Z, three hours before the first red run. The test itself was not changed between the last green run and the first red one. That makes the pin bump the first suspect, but the bisect is NOT MEASURED.

## Two readings, not decided here

1. The console stopped rendering a `fieldGroups[].icon` as an svg in the section header: a user-visible regression in objectui's record-detail field groups.
2. The header's DOM changed shape (the icon no longer sits in a `div` whose direct child is the title `span`), and the locator is stale while the icon still renders.

The run artifacts (`showcase-smoke-diagnostics`: screenshot, trace and `error-context.md`, artifact ids `12093498075` and `12129556062`, 7-day retention) decide between the two. This session cannot download Actions artifacts.

## Done when

- The two readings are told apart from the artifacts or a local run against the pinned console.
- Then either the console renders the icon again (an objectui fix and a pin move) or the locator is re-aimed at the header's real shape, keeping the "not literal icon-name text" assertion.
- `Showcase Smoke` is green on `main`.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, closed included:
- objectstack, `showcase smoke detail-shapes fieldGroup Money header icon svg not visible collapsed`: 0 hits. Control: `showcase smoke e2e failure app-showcase playwright` gave 9 hits, among them #22992, #4931 and #5915 (earlier showcase-smoke cards, all closed), so the instrument reaches this subject. None of those is this assertion.
- objectui, `detail fieldGroup section header icon not rendered Money banknote`: 1 hit, objectui#4632 (closed 2026-08-14, `ToggleGroupItem.icon`), which is a different component.

Dedupe words: showcase smoke detail-shapes Money header icon; fieldGroups icon svg section header; console pin 5e15928b4631 showcase red.
